mapper.update: UPDATE DEN_USERS_LOGIN SET EMAIL_AUTH_DT = now() WHERE SEQ_NBR = #{seqNbr}
mapper.select: SELECT L.SEQ_NBR AS seqNbr, DATE_FORMAT(L.PSWD_AUTH_DT, '%Y/%m/%d %H:%i:%s') AS pswdAuthDt, DATE_FORMAT(L.EMAIL_AUTH_DT, '%Y/%m/%d %H:%i:%s') AS emailAuthDt FROM DEN_USERS_LOGIN L WHERE L.EMAIL = #{email} ORDER BY SEQ_NBR DESC LIMIT 1
